Condition : 2 - No music shall be played on the premises in such a way as to
    be audible within any adjoining premises or on the adjoining
    highway at any time.

Condition : 3 - No sound emanating from the use shall be audible within any
    adjoining premises between 20.00 hrs at night and 08.00 hrs
    in the morning.

Condition : 4 - All the existing windows on the west boundary wall, which is
    to be retained, to be reglazed in obscured glass before the
    development is occupied for teaching or residential
    purposes.

Condition : 5 - Before the sui generis use commences, details of the method
    of refuse storage and frequency of removal shall be
    submitted to and approved by the Council and the approved
    method shall thereafter be maintained.  The details shall
    include details for the educational use and the residential
    use.

Condition : 7 - The educational teaching use hereby permitted shall not be
    carried out outside the following times 9am to 7pm Mondays
    to Fridays.  It shall not be carried out at any time on
    Saturdays, Sundays or Bank Holidays.

Condition : 15 - Use of the premises in any way other than that set out in

Condition : 16 - There is a statutory requirement to provide sanitary

    the provisions of Section 4 of the Chronically Sick and
    Disabled Persons Act 1970 and the Building Regulations 1991
    Access and facilities for disabled people.  You are advised
    to consult Camden Building Control, Camden Town Hall, Argyle
    Street, London WC1H 8EQ. Tel 020 7413 6941.

Condition : 17 - The development hereby approved does not include permission
    for any air conditioning plant or equipment.  It is
    considered that such plant could not easily be accommodated
    as part of the development, by reason of likely detriment to
    residential amenity.  You are therefore informed that it is
    unlikely that planning permission would be granted for such
    plant and equipment.
description:
Part redevelopment and change of use from use as car park
and Class B1 use, to a sui generis educational use on the
whole site comprising classrooms, office and 12 single or
double student study bedrooms, which include self contained
shower rooms and kitchenettes,
as shown by drawing numbers 383/01C, 02C and 03 (existing)
and 04 (roof plan), letter dated 15.11.1999 from Marshall
Hatchick.
